blocks.content: To create this project, we will first create a class named Game.
This class will have three private member variables:

items: user_pick - to store the user's pick
computer_pick - to store the computer's pick
result - to store either "win", "lose", or "draw" based on the user's pick and the computer's pick

blocks.content: We have made these variables private because they are sensitive game data, and should be handled with care.
